observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor dirt or grass clearing, surrounded by a large crowd of spectators, with large stack of loudspeakers visible on the right
observation.dancers: mixed group of young adults and teenagers, men and women, dancing in couples and small groups
observation.formation_and_space: informal circle of spectators with couples dancing in the center space
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees, body bouncing to the beat, occasional deep knee bends
observation.footwork: quick shifting of weight, stepping side-to-side and in place, low steps on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held near the torso or raised, sometimes holding hands with partner or resting on hips
observation.hips_and_torso: frequent hip movements, rolling hips, and torso bouncing or pelvic movement toward a partner
observation.partnering: couples facing each other with close proximity, pelvic positioning near partner without full body grip
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low levels with deep squats and hip thrusts, minimal jumps, occasional spins
observation.costume_and_props: casual clothing including white shirts, patterned skirts, shorts, and pants
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and precise weight distribution are obscured by low video resolution and camera angles

instruments: electronic speakers playing recorded percussion and bass hea

signature_moments.what: a dancer in yellow shorts crouches low with knees bent, bouncing while facing a partner who steps around in place
a female dancer drops into a low knee bend and shakes her hips rapidly while facing another dancer
a dancer in a camo shirt crouches low on the floor, thrusting hips toward a partner while stepping circularly
